user.title: Add an Insoma valve
user.description: Select a 433.926 MHz RF transmitter and enter the OFF code of a remote already paired with your valve. ON will always use a timed watering command.

data_description.off_code: Full 16-bit OFF code in decimal or hexadecimal with a 0x prefix (for example, 0xB750 or 0x24E0). The last hexadecimal digit must be 0.

error.invalid_off_code: Enter a 16-bit OFF code whose last hexadecimal digit is 0, such as 0xB750. Do not enter a timed or permanent-ON code.
error.invalid_transmitter: Select a compatible 433.926 MHz OOK transmitter.

abort.already_configured: This valve remote is already configured.
abort.no_transmitters: Add an RF transmitter to Home Assistant before setting up Insoma RF.
abort.no_compatible_transmitters: No RF transmitter supports 433.926 MHz with OOK modulation.

invalid_duration.message: Select a watering duration of 5, 10, 30, 60, 90, or 120 minutes before turning the valve on.
